title: Does not stay sharp - dull within 5 uses
text: Does not stay sharp - dull within 5 uses. Wanted to like this. Looks really good, and feels good in your hand. Sadly, after about a half dozen uses, it is no longer sharp enough to cut through a normal pizza. I have no idea what went wrong, perhaps the blade was not properly sharpened in the first place? At any rate, I have never cut anything but pizza with it, either in the pizza box it was delivered in, or on a wooden cutting board. I have seriously used this perhaps 5 times. Not recommended. The search resumes.

product_metadata.title: OXO Good Grips Stainless Steel 4-Inch Pizza Wheel and Cutter
features: Sharp stainless steel blade accommodates even thick-crust pizza
Safe, die cast zinc thumb guard
description: Slice through mushrooms, pepperoni, and extra cheese with ease with the OXO Good Grips 4-inch Pizza Wheel. Its sharp stainless steel blade cuts through crunchy crust, and is large enough to accommodate Sicilian and thick-crust pizzas. A die cast zinc thumb guard keeps fingers away from the blade for added safety, and the large, soft handle absorbs pressure.

You can rely on this wheel to make a complete cut through your pizza pie on the first run, thanks to its beveled stainless-steel blade. It works equally well with other pie doughs, and you can use without fear of cutting yourself, thanks to its built-in thumb guard.

The Good Grips line features durable, nonslip, flexible handles on every product. Ergonomically designed to fit the palm comfortably, the pressure-absorbing, processed rubber handle puts less tension on the hands, while still providing an outstanding grip. Made from the same material as dishwasher gaskets, the handles are slip-proof, wet or dry, as well as dishwasher-safe. Good Grips products are moderately priced and have won the Tylenol/Arthritis Foundation Design Award.
